statement_made: The decision is imminent, but I’ve got to be clear—my relationship with Mike (McCarthy) is better than it’s ever been.
event_description: Addressing rumors regarding his potential retirement and his reunion with Mike McCarthy in Pittsburgh.

statement_made: I’m treating the booth like the film room now. I’m done trying to 'sound' like a broadcaster.
event_description: Discussing his tactical shift in broadcasting style during his second full year with FOX Sports.

statement_made: Green Bay is where I grew up as a pro. Getting this extension means the work is just beginning.
event_description: Reacting to his $50.3 million contract extension with the Packers.

statement_made: The tag is what it is. I’m here to show Dallas why they shouldn't let me hit the market again.
event_description: Commenting on playing for the Cowboys under the franchise tag after a surprise off-season move.

statement_made: My immediate reaction was it's just time to run it back again. Reunion with Quinn and the guys is a blessing.
event_description: Expressing excitement after being drafted by the Dolphins and reuniting with former Texas teammates.

statement_made: Seattle believed in me from day one. This contract is for the city that took a chance on me.
event_description: Confirming his massive four-year, $168.6 million extension with the Seahawks.

statement_made: Tag or no tag, I’m the best back in the league. The numbers don’t lie, even if the contracts do.
event_description: Reacting to the New York Jets placing the franchise tag on him for the 2026 season.

statement_made: I know there’s pressure being the guy to follow Stafford, but I’ve been preparing for this my whole life.
event_description: First public statement after being drafted 13th overall by the Los Angeles Rams.

statement_made: There’s no tension. I have the utmost respect for the Rooney family, regardless of how Draft night looked.
event_description: Clearing the air regarding a perceived conflict with the Steelers front office during the 2026 Draft.

statement_made: Denver’s altitude is just going to make the 'Waddle' celly look even faster.
event_description: Expressing optimism following his high-profile trade from Miami to the Denver Broncos.

statement_made: If the arm still works and the team still wants me, why would I be anywhere else but on a field?
event_description: Commenting on signing a veteran deal with the Cincinnati Bengals at age 41.

statement_made: Duval is home. We’re building a championship defense here, and I’m glad to be a pillar of it.
event_description: Announcing his four-year, $110 million contract extension with the Jacksonville Jaguars.

statement_made: I’m ready for a fresh start in New York. The Jets are building something special in the secondary.
event_description: Reacting to his trade from the Dolphins and subsequent extension with the New York Jets.

statement_made: Every time I go to a concert, people think I’m retiring. I’m just enjoying life and football, alright?
event_description: Shutting down retirement rumors on a live episode of the New Heights podcast.

statement_made: I never doubted the return. The work was hard, but Cleveland never stopped believing in me.
event_description: Reflecting on his successful return to form following a devastating knee injury.

statement_made: Year three is when the vision really comes together. Chicago deserves a winner, and we’re close.
event_description: Setting goals for the 2026 season after establishing himself as the Bears' franchise cornerstone.

statement_made: Jim brings a level of intensity that changes the whole building. It’s exactly what we needed.
event_description: Praising head coach Jim Harbaugh's impact on the Chargers organization during their first season together.

statement_made: If the 'system' wins games, then I’m happy to be a part of it. The ring is the only validation I need.
event_description: Responding to critics who labeled him a 'system quarterback' during the 49ers' Super Bowl run.

statement_made: I’m basically a professional cheerleader now, and the pay is surprisingly similar.
event_description: Joking about his post-retirement life during a live 'New Heights' tour event.

statement_made: I know the fans are hurt, but this was a business decision for my family and my future.
event_description: Explaining his decision to leave the New York Giants for the rival Philadelphia Eagles.
